messages:
Riley: quick post-demo note — gateway blocked on admission during a burst and we surfaced 503s. Need a boundary so gw doesn't wait on long lease reconcilers.
Jun: can you paste the tiny trace? wondering if it was token checkout or reconcile.
Riley: tail:
```
2026-03-20T11:02:09Z ingress-gw WARN req=zzz hold=admission wait=980ms
2026-03-20T11:02:09Z admission ERR req=zzz reconcile=slow
2026-03-20T11:02:09Z ingress-gw ERR req=zzz respond=503
```
Sasha: two short options: (A) gw early-fast-fail if admission slow (keeps p99 tight), (B) gw accepts TEMP_GRANT with short TTL and tags it provisional while admission reconciles. Both affect fairness/abuse signals.
Omar: proto sketch:
```
message RateGrant { enum Mode { ALLOW=0; TEMP_ALLOW=1; DENY=2 } Mode mode=1; string grant_id=2; int32 temp_ttl_ms=3; string deprioritize_queue=4; }
```
Riley: runtime behavior: if TEMP_ALLOW -> gw allows request, marks provisional=true, routes to low-priority queue, and records grant_id for reconciliation. Add a small in-gw memo cache key=(tenant,route) ttl~600ms to cut stampedes.
Jun: billing: prefer charge-on-issue + reconcile refunds on revoke (simpler accounting; discourages abuse). Need refund audit trail.
Sasha: telemetry: temp_issued, temp_revoked, temp_revoked_rate, temp_ttl_hist, reconcile_refunds_total, per-route latency tagged provisional. Alerts if temp_revoked_rate > 2% over 5m.
Omar: canary plan: stage smoke -> 1% prod (embeddings/short routes) 48h -> 5% if OK. Add a synthetic burst sim to validate fairness before canary.
Riley: owners: Riley -> RFC+proto, Omar -> gateway + cache, Sasha -> refunds & audit, Jun -> telemetry+alerts. I'll open RFC and link PRs.
Jun: also simulate edge-case: many temporaries revoked in batch -> ensure reconcile pipeline is slow-safe and refunds rate-limited.
Sasha: agreed. I'll draft refund policy (soft refund window + audit).
Riley: thanks all. I'll circle back after RFC. :thumbsup:
